assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read in full: #reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the canonical V2 character monograph SHOKUGEKI_ERINA_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md (status canonical, readiness validated_model by the project's label), consolidated from the project's complete original-Japanese V01-V36 sequential reread including Le dessert, with archive-image locators and supplementary comics at lower weight. The monograph's readiness label, noncanonical probes and H/M/U confidence levels are inputs, not conclusions. The linked deep readings, ledgers, evidence matrix and validation and fidelity audits are not curated on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; nor is anything borrowed from the Yukihira Soma, Ikumi Mito or Aldini Takumi capability records or models. assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Nakiri Erina from the retrospective pre-Azami childhood and early Joichiro encounter, through the early evaluator state (01-108 to 02-018, 05-006 to 05-048), V08, V10-V11 and V13-V14, Azami's return and refuge (16-158 to 18-054, 19-057 to 19-087), the train exam and Hokkaido (21-006 to 22-036), refusal and the Régiment (24-098 to 24-178, V25-V30, final course 30-021 to 30-184), headmaster office (31-018 to 31-054), the BLUE regression (35-009 to 35-111) and the V36 final (36-084 to 36-157), to the Présent, Passé and Futur endpoints (36-171 to 36-243). The boundary limits evidence, not what she knows. Capability states split at located changes: early evaluator (V01 onward); Azami's return and refuge (V16-V18); counter-pedagogue and rebel leader (V20-V24, Tenth Seat resigned at 24-098 to 24-178); final-course partner (V29-V30); headmaster and BLUE burden (V31-V35, regression under Mana at 35-009 to 35-111); BLUE final and authorship for Mana (V36 to 36-145); terminal adult (Présent, Passé and Futur, kept separate). Default when time is unspecified is the terminal adult, as the monograph specifies.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph states a competing motive hierarchy (uphold exact culinary standards, be worthy of a burdensome inheritance, preserve valued people, and eventually author an answer that is hers), a recognition dependence that can reorganize her effort (Joichiro's earlier food, Hisako's return, Soma's challenge, Mana's withheld approval), an attentional bias (she detects tiny culinary defects faster than the relational assumptions around her own authority) and a conditional rule table keyed by trigger, state and recipient with H/M/U confidence and exceptions. The discriminators are explicit: a flawed dish in ordinary work produces exact correction (V13, V30); a low-status applicant threatening her early status narrative produces public dismissal that can contradict her taste (01-108 to 02-018); Azami's approach produces freezing and contraction despite recent warmth (16-158 to 18-054); sabotaged students produce teaching of ingredient properties rather than finished answers (21-006 to 21-188); Mana's cure burden produces overwork, isolation and rejection of good food (35-009 to 35-111); choosing Mana as recipient produces a new authored dish (36-133 to 36-137). It predicts her harms and mistakes, not only growth: early humiliation of less powerful people, V35 cruelty to a competent losing plate, and objection to Soma's unconsulted changes even after success. Not A: no probe or validation result is part of this evidence set, and adult governance, unknown juniors and medical futures are outside it. Not C: the record can say which condition decides her response (who is present, what her attention is made to carry, whether the task is addressable) and states where that account stops.

The state architecture gives six organized states with activation and exit limits (early evaluator; Azami's return and refuge; counter-pedagogue and rebel leader; final-course partner; headmaster and BLUE burden; terminal adult), located by archive range: 16-158 to 18-054, 21-006 to 24-178, 30-021 to 30-184, 31-018 to 31-054, 35-009 to 35-111 and 36-084 to 36-145, with the serialized ending, Présent, Passé and Futur kept separate. It treats V35 as decisive counterevidence against linear recovery after Central and keeps the pre-Azami playful childhood (retrospective) from making coldness her essence. Not A: no volume key or locator covers V03-V04, V06-V07, V09, V12, V15, V23 or V32-V34, and the adult state rests on epilogue montage. Not C: each state has its own triggers, exit limits and countercase.

Register rules are explicit and conditioned on perceived safety: polished categorical dismissal and technical precision under public evaluation; contracted speech near Azami; irritation, embarrassment, play and reciprocal command with peers; cold severity under Mana's burden; rival exchange and future-facing family speech in V36. The Japanese section names 私 with refined feminine endings, permission, rejection and direct imperatives as claimed judging rights, お父様 kept in a distancing farewell, awkward personal address to Hisako in V31, V30 お粗末!! as a borrowed service position, and 不味い as five distinct pragmatic acts. Not B: few located strings are quoted, the voice ledger the monograph depends on is not curated on this subject, and the monograph itself forbids inventing nickname or first-person inventories. Not D: the register is conditioned per recipient and state rather than described generically.

A dedicated ordinary-life section gives a conditional account: sheltered inexperience with unscripted leisure and curiosity once inside it (the lower-weight supplementary pool outing and summer testing with Hisako, V08); shōjo manga, difficulty navigating ordinary life without Hisako and the return embrace (V10, V13-V14); the Hokkaido trip with tea, sightseeing, laughter and lingering, with Megumi and Mito as active participants (21-120 to 22-036); and the typed rule that help may be requested indirectly or irritably and that embarrassment becomes denial, altered gaze or displaced attention to food. Not B: some windows are supplementary comics of lower weight, and leisure frequency, entertainment titles, shopping habits and daily schedule are stated as unavailable. Not D: the account is conditional, not a list of scattered scenes.

Partner-specific, directional deltas are located: Hisako from attendant to friend with explicit reciprocal naming and practiced, not instant, equality (13-043 to 13-136, 17-036 to 18-054, 30-170 to 30-180, adult 36-209 to 36-215); Alice's burned letters and escape leadership (19-057 to 19-087); Megumi's care without repayment and her self-correction (21-120 to 22-036, 35-046 to 35-064); Azami refused politically and denied atonement by leaving (24-098 to 24-178, 36-200 to 36-205); Mana's rejection, the chosen dish and later meals (35-029 to 35-036, 36-133 to 36-176); Soma from irritant to coauthor and privileged adult absence (01-108 to 02-018, 29-006 to 30-184, 36-224 to 36-243). The matched-recipient section states how the same criticism or offer of help changes for Hisako, Soma, Megumi, Alice and an unknown first-year (M). Not A: Ryo, Senzaemon, Joichiro and juniors are thin, and adult family repair is montage. Not C: conditioning is explicit, repeated and bounded per partner and state.

The monograph locates private states (fear before refusal is possible near Azami, private recognition of enjoyment after the pool outing, privately wanting Soma's return and cooking, dread and shame under Mana's cure demand) and analyzes their causal role. Not B: most affect is inferred from action, the monograph warns against inferring motive from a harsh word or a blush, and few of her own self-accounts are quoted. Not D: competing motives and their activation conditions are analyzed across states.

Located conflict with conditions: early status defense (01-108 to 02-018); freezing and then chosen movement while afraid when Azami returns (16-158 to 18-054); resigning the Tenth Seat, naming herself against Azami and accepting reciprocal Régiment risk (24-098 to 24-178); rested-cook roster selection and support for those waiting (V25-V27); discarding a preset answer under Soma's provocation, authoring the oyakodon-centered main and assigning his labor (30-021 to 30-184); a 3-0 Noir sweep with severe treatment of a losing dish (35-009 to 35-111); and the final for Mana (36-084 to 36-145). The rule table states exceptions (successful provocation does not preauthorize unconsulted changes). Not A: the BLUE final ballot and detailed comparative reasoning are not shown, and adult conflict with unknown juniors is unshown. Not C: triggers, policies and exceptions are explicit.

Located positions: teaching ingredient properties so students author their own answers (21-006 to 21-188), refusing Azami's doctrine and office (24-098 to 24-178), naming freedom and relational causation after the final course (30-021 to 30-184), rejecting Azami's atonement by leaving in favor of non-solitary accountability without absolution (36-200 to 36-205), and the V35 counter-case in which inherited rescue pressure makes good food deserve disposal. The monograph's nonclaims separate her palate from moral or political authority. Not B: her own stated reasoning between competing goods is rarely quoted, and governance safeguards and complete family accountability are named gaps. Not D: positions are located and change with identified conditions. The discovery row does not enroll an ethics dimension; this grade rests on the behavioral and psychological evidence it does enroll.

Distributed evidence: play, appetite and reciprocal command with peers (21-006 to 24-178), laughter at a crude salmon-skin comparison on the Hokkaido trip, 不味い as comic intimacy with Soma, and smiling at adult Soma's failed experiment while refusing the positive verdict (36-224 to 36-243). Not C: the monograph gives no account of how she jokes or plays beyond the rivalry exchange. Not E: the material recurs across peer and adult states.

One dedicated canonical monograph (readiness validated_model by the project's own label) consolidated from the complete original-Japanese V01-V36 V2 reread including Le dessert, with archive-image locators, supplementary comics weighted lower and defective or obscured images (26-137, 36-114, 36-258) excluded. Not B: it is a single synthesis; the deep readings, ledgers and the full-series and reconstruction-fidelity audits it routes to are not curated on this subject; and no locator covers V03-V04, V06-V07, V09, V12, V15, V23 or V32-V34. Not D: every arc in which she is a principal has located, dedicated analysis.

Affirmative limits stated as rules and located: her palate is not infallibility or moral authority; receiving help does not make her passive and helpers are not sole rescuers (17-036 to 18-054); V35 cruelty is not excused as excellence (35-026 to 35-041); her BLUE title prevents any prize-of-the-semifinal model (36-153 to 36-157); headmaster office does not prove reform (31-018 to 31-054); family meals do not erase abuse or certify Mana's cure (36-171 to 36-176); V36 does not show her ratifying Megumi's V35 wager; private longing does not establish a couple (36-224 to 36-243); and an explicit negative-control list. Not A: several limits are interpretive bounds, not tested predictions. Not C: each is located and stated as a rule.

The monograph requires reading the developmental states before transferring a rule, specifies the default state when time is unspecified (terminal adult), keeps the serialized ending, Présent, Passé and Futur separate, states that VV-NNN locators are archive images rather than printed pages, and confines the V35 regression to its family, illness and evaluation context. Not A: some volumes are uncited and in-world dates are not given. Not C: state boundaries and their activation limits are explicit.

conditions: Output is illustrative, never attributed quotation, and names one state: early evaluator (V01 onward); Azami's return and refuge (V16-V18); counter-pedagogue and rebel leader (V20-V24, Tenth Seat resigned at 24-098 to 24-178); final-course partner (V29-V30); headmaster and BLUE burden (V31-V35, regression under Mana at 35-009 to 35-111); BLUE final and authorship for Mana (V36 to 36-145); terminal adult (Présent, Passé and Futur, kept separate).

Interlocutors are those the evidence samples (Hisako, Soma, Megumi, Alice, the Polar Star group, Azami, Mana, students she teaches); with an unknown first-year only professional diagnostic language, as a lower-confidence transfer.

Speech keeps 私, refined feminine endings, technical precision and categorical judgment conditioned on perceived safety; 不味い is used only with the pragmatic act the state supports; no invented nickname or first-person inventory and no automatic tsundere reversal.
No confession, declared couple or cured-Mana dialogue is generated.
scenario_readiness.note: Under the owner rulings the question is whether the evidence constrains generated speech enough for the declared use. The register-by-safety rules, the recipient matching and the Japanese section constrain stance and form for illustrative speech in the sampled states and relations; the scarcity of quoted strings is uncertainty about exact wording, carried by the conditions.

Output keeps sheltered unfamiliarity with unscripted leisure together with curiosity and enjoyment once engaged, help requested indirectly or irritably, awkward gratitude that becomes direct, and embarrassment displaced onto food or denial.

scenario_readiness.note: Supported by the ordinary-life section (V08 supplementary outing, V10 and V13-V14 dependence and return, 21-120 to 22-036 Hokkaido trip) and the Megumi tea rule; the monograph types preferences and marks leisure frequency unavailable.

conditions: The dilemma concerns teaching versus authoring another cook's answer, refusing coercive family or institutional authority, accountability for a family member without absolution, or how to judge a competent but losing dish, with the state stated.

Governance safeguards, democratic legitimacy, medical decisions and complete family accountability are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located positions at 21-006 to 21-188, 24-098 to 24-178, 30-021 to 30-184 and 36-200 to 36-205, with V35 as the counter-case, support bounded dilemmas within culinary, pedagogical and family settings.

The monograph affirmatively bounds the Soma relation as strongly romantically implied but not confessed, formalized or completed (36-224 to 36-243) and lists any explicitly partnered reconstruction as going beyond the evidence. A romance-relationship scenario requires a relation state the source withholds. Her unconfessed rival attachment remains usable under the DIALOGUE and CROSS_SCENARIO conditions.

conditions: The setting is sensory diagnosis, cooking, ingredient pedagogy, kitchen coordination, roster decisions, culinary competition or headmaster administrative work, with the state named.

Output preserves exact fault-specific correction, knowledge that enlarges others' capacity rather than prescribing their dish, and tactical selection of rested cooks, and keeps the V35 severity tied to Mana's cure burden.
Routine governance safeguards, the BLUE final ballot, institutional reform outcomes and medical authority are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Her most densely evidenced domain: the 407-serving benchmark (05-006 to 05-048), Excellence corrections (V13), Hokkaido pedagogy (21-006 to 21-188), Régiment roster and final-course command (V25-V30), headmaster labor (31-018 to 31-054) and BLUE (V35-V36).

known_limits.statement: Her palate does not become less exact as her relations widen; what changes is who may answer, what an imperfect dish means, and whether she carries every future alone. Harsh criticism is not translated into secret affection by default.
Conditioned freezing near Azami belongs to the refuge period (16-158 to 18-054); a warm dorm meal does not erase it, and it is not assumed for adult family contact (36-200 to 36-205).

The V35 return to ice-witch severity has a specific family, illness and evaluation context (35-009 to 35-111); it is neither a universal adult mood nor erasure of friendship, teaching or prior refusal.
Legitimate expertise multiplies authors: in the train exam she teaches ingredient properties and the students' different plates are theirs (21-006 to 21-188).

Refuge from Alice, Hisako, Ryo and Polar Star widens her options without making them owners of her recovery, and Soma is catalytic while Erina authors the final course and the dish for Mana (17-036 to 18-054; 30-021 to 30-184; 36-133 to 36-137).
Mana's later meals do not certify a cure or account for the bracket harm (36-171 to 36-176), and the Soma relation is not confessed, formalized or completed (36-224 to 36-243).
She is BLUE Grand Champion with Soma runner-up and no score shown (36-153 to 36-157); no model makes her his prize or subordinate, and the title does not prove universal superiority.
Headmaster office after 31-018 to 31-054 is evidence of agency, not of democratic legitimacy or completed institutional reform.

With an unknown first-year, professional diagnostic language is plausible but intimate teasing and trusted-rival provocation are unearned; the monograph rates this case M because a complete adult ordinary interaction is unshown.
No detail is reconstructed from the defective 26-137, obscured small text on 36-114 or the duplicate back cover 36-258, and supplementary comics carry lower weight.
The monograph's validated_model label and current_validated authority state are project labels and inputs, not this assessment's tier.

The monograph names routine governance safeguards, ordinary conflicts with unknown juniors, the medical future of the God Tongue, complete family accountability, the BLUE final ballot and explicit romance as material gaps; the evidence set cannot say how she behaves there.

The deep readings, the character-state, voice, relationship and readiness ledgers, the evidence matrix and the full-series and reconstruction-fidelity audits linked from the monograph are not curated on this subject, so their warrants and any validation results were not used here.
The monograph cites no volume key or locator for several volumes, V03-V04, V06-V07, V09, V12, V15, V23 and V32-V34, so her behavior there is not established by this evidence set.
